description: This file defines a helper class 'Sample' used in example scripts for the PhpSpreadsheet library. The class provides utility methods for common tasks such as environment detection, file handling, chart rendering, logging, and sample management within the PhpSpreadsheet project.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Helper class providing utility methods for samples, environment detection, file handling, logging, and rendering within phpSpreadsheet example scripts.

methods.name: isCli
methods.description: Detects if the script is running in the command line interface.

methods.name: getScriptFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the currently executing script.

methods.name: isIndex
methods.description: Checks if the current script is 'index.php'.

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Returns the page title based on whether the script is the index.

methods.name: getPageHeading
methods.description: Returns the page heading HTML element or empty if index.

methods.name: getSamples
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sample files organized by category from the samples directory.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a spreadsheet to files in specified formats, optionally with charts, and handles callbacks.

methods.name: isDirOrMkdir
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists or attempts to create it.

methods.name: getTemporaryFolder
methods.description: Returns the temporary directory path, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Generates a filename for sample output in the temporary directory with the desired extension.

methods.name: getTemporaryFilename
methods.description: Creates a temporary filename with a specified extension.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a message with a timestamp, adjusted for CLI or web environment.

methods.name: renderChart
methods.description: Renders a chart to a PNG file and displays it if not in CLI.

methods.name: titles
methods.description: Logs the title of a sample function with optional description.

methods.name: displayGrid
methods.description: Displays a matrix as a text grid (probably for CLI debugging).

methods.name: logCalculationResult
methods.description: Logs the result of a worksheet cell calculation including description.

methods.name: logEndingNotes
methods.description: Logs final notes and peak memory usage.

methods.name: logWrite
methods.description: Logs the time taken to write a file with a formatter type.

methods.name: logRead
methods.description: Logs the time taken to read a file with a formatter type.
